name: Losant
tagline: Industrial IoT platform API for devices, workflows, data tables, and experiences
description: Losant is an industrial IoT application platform whose REST API provides access to nearly every platform feature, including applications, devices, workflows, data tables, and experiences. Most endpoints require a scoped API access token sent as a Bearer token. Its resource-based endpoints support device provisioning and state, workflow actions, data management, and experience management.

auth.details: API token via Authorization: Bearer header (or token query param); create tokens in application or user settings after signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Developer Sandbox: no cost and no credit card required; up to 10 connected devices; 30-day data retention. Additional Sandbox resource and payload limits apply, and over-limit payloads are rejected.

rate_limits: Endpoint-specific, not global. Device Send State, Send Command, and Set Connection Status allow 30 calls per 15 seconds per device; Workflow Press Virtual Button allows 100 calls per 10 seconds per virtual button. Other endpoint limits apply.

example.request: curl -s -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Accept: application/json' -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_ACCESS_TOKEN' -X GET 'https://api.losant.com/applications'

use_cases: list applications and devices in a Losant org
query device state or attributes for IoT assets
read or write data table rows for industrial data
trigger or inspect workflows for automation
manage experience users and endpoints for multi-tenant apps
